events.title: Campaign Kickoff Rally
events.description: Join us for the official launch of the Keep Judge Langford 2026 campaign at Blak Koffee on June 5th, 2026

events.title: Campaign Fundraiser Dinner
events.description: An evening reception and fundraiser dinner to support Judge Langford's re-election campaign. Enjoy a wonderful evening while helping ensure that experienced, fair judicial leadership continues in Jefferson County. Sponsorship opportunities are available.

events.title: Community Town Hall
events.description: An open community forum where Judge Langford will speak directly with Jefferson County residents, answer questions about her judicial record, and discuss her priorities for the court if re-elected. All community members are welcome — free admission.

events.title: Volunteer Phone Bank & Canvass Days
events.description: Join our volunteer team for organized phone banking and door-to-door canvassing events across Jefferson County. No experience needed — we will train you! Every conversation you have with a voter makes a real difference in this election.

events.location: Polling locations across Jefferson County, Kentucky
events.title: Election Day — Vote!
events.description: Polls are open from 7:00 am to 7:00 pm in Jefferson County, Kentucky. Vote for Judge Lisa L. Langford for District Court Judge and encourage everyone you know to do the same!
